steps.description:
The code below will display the Ultrasonic sensor value when it is less than 5. 


Although not often, it is possible to see numbers bigger than 5 being displayed. This is because the code reads the sensor twice. The first time for checking that it is less than 5, the second time to display. These two values may differ and the second reading can be bigger or equal to 5.

The code can be more reliable using a variable as shown. The variable value will be consistent for checking and displaying.





Complete the conditions for the code below by checking the variable such that:
  1. When an obstacle is more than 20cm away, a slow beeping sound will be played.
  2. When an obstacle is less than 10cm away, a fast beeping sound will be played.
